title: I really liked this unit---WHEN IT WORKED!
text: I really liked this unit---WHEN IT WORKED!. I really liked this unit -- WHEN IT WORKED!  It failed to heat the water 5 times in the first 3 weeks of use (Maybe 20 to 25 total cycles).  Perhaps it was a bad sensor or on/off switch, but clearly quality control was not up to par.  Luckily I was able to return the unit through Amazon in the first 30 days.  I was willing to get a replacement rather than a refund, but "replacement" was not an option, only a refund.  If you buy this unit be sure to test it thoroughly immediately and also keep all packing materials and boxes so you can return it safely if your unit fails to heat water.
